title: Nightly TicWatch Pro / MM2 / Pixel 2 XL Android 10 issues after install
symptom: After installing the 21st Jan nightly, the TicWatch Pro is nearly unusable with incredibly slow response to screen presses, connects to MM2 but drops connections after the first reading, and the screen goes blank requiring button presses to show data. Earlier versions had connection drops after several hours unless Force Wear Collection Service was enabled, and battery drain increased.
cause: The issue was caused by performing an in-place upgrade over a previous installation instead of uninstalling and reinstalling cleanly. The user found that after a clean install, the 21st Jan nightly worked well.
fix: Uninstall the app from the phone and watch, then perform a clean install of the latest nightly (2020.01.21). The user confirmed this resolved the major issues, with only occasional Bluetooth disconnects.
evidence_quote: Once it was installed cleanly - the 21st Jan nightly is working well - only had one disconnect from Ticwatch over night
